description_zh: 暂停或开启云蜜罐实例
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-vpc-honey-pot --vpc-id vpc-d7o009q63fqy21r8u0000 --honey-pot-action disable --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpcHoneyPot

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) on which the honeypot is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~) operation to query the IDs of VPCs
parameters.help_zh:
要生效的云蜜罐实例的VPC ID。

您可以调用[DescribeVpcHoneyPotList](~~DescribeVpcHoneyPotList~~)接口获取VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the honeypot. Valid values:

disable
enable
parameters.help_zh:
指定暂停或开启云蜜罐实例。取值：

disable：暂停
enable：开启
parameters.name: honey_pot_action

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
